title: Intro to Embedded AI
description: Dive into the intersection of microcontrollers and machine learning. Learn to deploy optimized neural network models on edge devices like ESP32 and STM32. Gain hands-on experience running real-time computer vision and sensor inference right on hardware.
speaker: Dr. Rajesh Kumar

title: Full-Stack Web Dev with React & Node
description: Master modern web development from interactive frontends to scalable backend architectures. Build and deploy a complete web application utilizing React, Node.js, Express, and REST APIs. Perfect for beginners and intermediate coders ready to turn ideas into live products.
speaker: Priya Sharma

title: ROS & Autonomous Navigation
description: Explore the fundamentals of robotics using Robot Operating System (ROS 2). Implement SLAM algorithms, path planning, and autonomous obstacle avoidance on simulated mobile robots. Take your first leap into the exciting world of autonomous robotics.
speaker: Prof. Ankit Verma

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
description: Step into the mindset of a penetration tester to uncover and patch critical security vulnerabilities. Learn real-world network reconnaissance, web app exploitation techniques, and defensive hardening strategies. Experience realistic capture-the-flag style security challenges.
speaker: Arjun Mehta (CTO, SecureNet)

title: PCB Design with KiCAD
description: Transform your breadboard prototypes into production-ready printed circuit boards. Learn schematic capture, component routing, design rule checking, and Gerber file generation using KiCAD. Walk away equipped to order and fabricate your own custom circuit boards.
speaker: Sneha Patel

title: Machine Learning with PyTorch
description: Demystify deep learning through hands-on model building using PyTorch. Train convolutional networks for computer vision, fine-tune pretrained models, and understand loss optimization. An intensive deep dive into modern artificial intelligence techniques.
speaker: Dr. Kavita Joshi

title: 3D Printing & CAD Modelling
description: Unleash your creativity and turn 3D designs into tangible physical prototypes. Master parametric 3D CAD modeling, slicing software calibration, and FDM printer operation. Discover rapid prototyping principles essential for modern hardware engineering.
speaker: Vikram Singh

title: Drone Building Workshop
description: Design, assemble, and configure your very own custom quadcopter drone from scratch. Learn flight mechanics, ESC calibration, brushless motor tuning, and transmitter telemetry setup. Conclude with an exhilarating outdoor test flight and tuning session.
speaker: Capt. Rohit Das

title: Blockchain & Smart Contracts
description: Unravel the core mechanics of decentralized applications, consensus mechanisms, and EVM architecture. Write, test, and deploy Solidity smart contracts using industry-standard tooling like Hardhat. Discover the future of Web3 and secure tokenized economies.
speaker: Neha Gupta (Founder, ChainLabs)

title: Competitive Programming Masterclass
description: Sharpen your algorithmic thinking and data structure prowess to conquer coding competitions and technical interviews. Master dynamic programming, graph traversal, and advanced tree techniques with an ICPC finalist. Learn practical problem-solving templates and speed-coding tricks.
speaker: Aditya Rao (ICPC Finalist)
